system.description:
Spend an Echo to manifest a distorted copy of yourself, called Fragment, within Close range. The Fragment shares your Evasion and traits.

You can use your senses and act as if you were in the Fragment’s space. You can move your Fragment as part of an action roll.

You can only maintain one Fragment at a time.

The Fragment lasts until the scene ends, you and it are not within Far range, you manifest another one, or it takes damage.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

system.gmNotes: The Fragment is not summoned automatically: place a token for it by hand. Spend Echo from the class feature that holds it: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so this Echo cost is paid by hand.
